identification: Berolinum Berlin, copper engraving by J.G. Ringlin after F.B. Werner, published by Martin Engelbrecht, Augsburg, c.1740. Hand-coloured, with title cartouche, arms cartouche and numbered key. Plate about 18 x 30.5 cm, 21 x 30.5 cm with key. Imprint matches dealer listings. Genuine retail copies are listed at roughly A$1,500, but those are asking prices from dealers in fine condition. This lot is foxed, glazed and in a later frame. No sold price seen anywhere.

viewing_check: Take the print out of the frame if allowed, or look at the edges: check for a plate mark (embossed rectangle), laid paper with chain lines and a watermark held to light, hand colour (brush strokes, slight bleed) versus printed dots under a loupe, and the three-line imprint at the bottom (Werner del., Ringlin sc., Engelbrecht excud. A.V.). Note foxing and any mat burn. Facsimile prints show dot screens and smooth machine paper.
